parameters.query: INSERT INTO shared_reports (token, report_type, client_id, title, expires_at, created_by) VALUES ('{{ $json.token }}', '{{ $json.report_type }}', {{ $json.client_id }}, '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.expires_at }}', '{{ $json.created_by }}') RETURNING *

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, report_url: 'https://' + ($env.N8N_HOST || 'localhost:5678') + '/webhook/reports/view/' + $json.token, expires_at: $json.expires_at, token: $json.token }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT sr.*, c.company_name, c.client_code FROM shared_reports sr JOIN clients c ON c.id = sr.client_id WHERE sr.token = '{{ $json.token }}' AND sr.expires_at > NOW() LIMIT 1

SELECT metrics FROM analytics_snapshots WHERE client_id = {{ $json.client_id || 0 }} AND source = '{{ $json.report_type === 'seo_weekly' ? 'seo_combined' : $json.report_type === 'marketing_monthly' ? 'marketing_crm' : 'executive_dashboard' }}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
